notes: Phase 1 Step 3 (LLM API candidate labeling) for Pass 5 (CWE-89 SQL Injection) against the arches_vuln source tree at sha 75ce8f7cb9c08caf608569797a40ca9be585b182, which equals the CodeQL database (arches-db) creation sha; every CSV line number was re-checked against the tree and each entry's first evidence string is the verbatim source line at its location, read from the tree at generation time.

Single-pass labeling run: Pass 5 only, per exploration/detection.json target.pass=5, cwes=[CWE-089]. passes contains a pass_id=1 stub with zero entries solely to satisfy labels_schema.json 'contains' (requires a pass_id=1 element); pass 1 (path traversal) was NOT labeled in this run and must be labeled separately before any pass-1 query generation.

All 2130 candidate rows (sources.csv 1906 + sinks.csv 224) were dispositioned; 51 exact-duplicate CSV rows merged (49 source rows across 41 duplicate groups + 2 sink rows), yielding 2079 CSV-backed entries plus 6 code-evidence sanitizer entries = 2085 entries total. Merge basis: all ten CSV columns identical (same node/file/line/flowKind/callable); each merge is recorded in labels_raw_pass5.json.

Labeling performed in-session by the agent's underlying LLM (glm-5.3); 5 batches (B1: all 224 sink rows, module-by-module with code verification of every execute/format/percent/concat/fstring site; B2: 811 HTTP-boundary source rows http_request/request_param/http_body/param; B3: 112 internal_transfer rows; B4: 409 cli rows; B5: 574 config/env/file rows). No external LLM API calls; temperature not applicable (deterministic reasoning over code evidence).

classification semantics: tp = confirmed genuine for the assigned role in this pass; fp = candidate rejected (role none); candidate = plausible but unresolved trust boundary, human review requested (kept for conservative recall); unknown = unused this run (no entry carries it). API-label tp does NOT equal vulnerability ground-truth TP; the confirmed pass-5 flows are listed in labels/phase1_review.md.

Signature flow_kind values follow labels_schema.json (param/argument/return/receiver/field/unknown). Extraction-family mapping: http_request/config/env/cli attribute or subscript loads -> field; request_param .get() calls -> return (the tainted value is the call result); file open()/read() calls -> return; http_body deserialize and internal_transfer rows -> argument at the captured positional index; handler param rows -> param at the parameter index; sink execute/callproc rows -> argument 0 (sql_text) / 1 (bound_params); SQL construction expression rows (percent/format/fstring/concat) -> unknown; internal_sql_wrapper function rows -> param. CSV argIndex -1 maps to null.

bound_params rows (execute/callproc argument index 1) are labeled role=sanitizer/classification=tp: they are the proven parameterized channel (values bound against %s placeholders, driver-escaped), implementing the WORKFLOW pass-5 heuristic 'parameterized queries/bound params -> FP as sinks'. This is a site-level channel label, not a claim that the whole call site is a vulnerability.

6 sanitizer entries were added from code evidence beyond the CSV candidates: uuid.UUID validation (models/concept.py:503), int() cast (views/concept.py:385), float() casts (views/search.py:456, map_filter.py:83), GEOSGeometry re-parse-and-hex-serialize (views/search.py:453, map_filter.py:80). No HTML-escaping/replace()-style pseudo-sanitizer was credited; auth decorators (@group_required) and CSRF middleware are contextual access constraints, not payload sanitizers (per references/django.md section 8).

Two CONFIRMED request-reachable SQL injection flows (both on unauthenticated RDM endpoints): (1) /concepts/paged_dropdown - request.GET 'query' -> sql.format at views/concept.py:424 -> execute :426, AND query -> get_child_collections_hierarchically(query=) -> get_child_edges subquery %-format at models/concept.py:635/:646 -> sql.format :653 -> execute :723; (2) /concepts/dropdown - request.GET 'conceptid' -> get_e55_domain -> .format(conceptid) at models/concept.py:1180-1202 -> execute :1216 (no uuid validation on this path). All other .execute sites are constant SQL (fp) or non-request trust boundaries (candidate).

Operator-trust candidates (not counted as confirmed vulnerabilities, per task constraints): CLI-driven identifier interpolation in export.py (:55/:61/:67), operator package .sql execution in packages.py (:611/:623), v3-migration file-data interpolation in v3migration.py (:49/:54), ORM-derived identifier interpolation in index_database.py (:314/:319/:343/:370), and settings-derived interpolation in setup_db.py (:102/:105 - labeled fp per admin-config heuristic). DB-derived UUID pk interpolations (models/concept.py:1154/:1160, datatypes.py:2131/:2138) are labeled fp with an explicit refactor-risk note.

Django ORM usage (filter/exclude/Q/objects.get) throughout the app compiles to parameterized SQL and contains no .raw()/.extra()/RawSQL()/from_statement()/executemany() anywhere in the snapshot (verified by grep) - ORM call sites are therefore not pass-5 sinks. SQLAlchemy TextClause / psycopg sql-object APIs are not used in the project.

No PyVul ground truth, vulnerability patch commits, CVE descriptions or external security advisories were consulted; project source, the CodeQL database, the Augur installation and the extraction artifacts were not modified. Only the four Phase-1 Step-3 artifacts under iris/labels/ (plus this generator script under iris/labels/scripts/) were written.

entries.rationale: "and depth < %s" % depth_limit: the depth_limit slot is constant on every reachable path - the concept() view overwrites the request-derived depth_limit with the literal 1 (views/concept.py:116) and other callers pass "" or None (empty limit/depth clause).

uuid.UUID(conceptid) validation guard in get_child_edges: non-UUID conceptid values short-circuit the function (except -> return []), and a valid UUID contains only hex digits and dashes - it cannot carry quote-breaking SQL payloads. Neutralizes the conceptid slot of the SQL assembled at :653/:713 for all callers (concept() view route param, paged_dropdown conceptid, concept-search removechildren). NOTE: this guard does NOT cover the `query` parameter of the same function (interpolated at :635/:646) nor get_e55_domain's conceptid (models/concept.py:1180) - those remain confirmed sinks.

int() cast on the paged_dropdown page parameter: the value feeding the offset arithmetic (and ultimately the numeric " limit %s offset %s" slot at models/concept.py:514) is coerced to an integer or raises; numeric values cannot break the SQL string.
float(width) cast in _buffer (search.py): the request-derived buffer width is coerced to a float (exception -> 0) before it is bound in the ST_BUFFER query; numeric values cannot carry SQL syntax.
float(width) cast in _buffer (map_filter.py), the search-component twin of views/search.py:_buffer: same numeric coercion before the bound parameter.

Moderate confidence because the parse-then-reserialize chain is indirect.
